name: Billiard Palace
description: Billiard Palace is a lively karaoke bar known for its extensive song library, friendly staff, and welcoming atmosphere. It offers private karaoke rooms, making it perfect for parties or intimate gatherings. The venue is well-maintained, clean, and provides a fun environment for all ages, with food and drinks available. Its vibrant crowd and quality sound system make it a top spot for karaoke enthusiasts seeking a memorable experience any day of the week.
